input.summary:
Stair hall furnished in parts/room-2.mjs: console table with a standing lantern as focal piece at the stair foot, hat pegs on the east wall, a dark oak stair seat, a stock barrel by the south arch, hanging lanterns down the centre lane and one under the landing, plus a floor lantern under the stair flight.
Clear lane x6 from the north arch to the south arch; mcd room reports OK with 49 of 53 floor cells reachable, min light 8, no dark or dim cells.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the Stair hall line shows 12 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes; the room view reads as a furnished hall from above.
left: Four floor cells at the hat-peg wall (x7, z14..16 and the cell at y8 z17) show as unreached in mcd room. They sit behind the pegs and the table, so the lane is unaffected and the room still reads OK; the walk tool has no climb, so this is the same kind of marking as the Lobby's belfry.
The inside eye view in room.png is blocked by the stair treads and reads as a close-up of timber, so the furnishing is judged from the above view only.
plan.md's checklist has no Stair hall line and elements.md has no item for this room, so nothing was ticked; the room's furnishing is recorded in the part's comment and this answer.
mcd check reports 1848 floating roof blocks and orphan slabs at z6/z7 and z30/z31 from other parts (roof and shopfronts not yet built); none come from the Stair hall.

waste.what: Worked out the 7-wide character rows for each height layer by hand, counting x2..x8 columns and z12..z22 rows for every piece.
waste.cost: about 4 layer tables and 11 rows each, plus one rebuild to fix a row offset
waste.tool: A helper that takes furniture as (block, x, y, z) or named spots (table at x7 z17, seat facing west at x5 z18) and writes the layers() rows itself, using the plan floor grid origin.

waste.what: Found the dim cell by running make.sh, then mcd room, then adding a lantern at the suggested spot and rebuilding, to clear 5 dim cells.
waste.cost: 2 full make.sh runs and 2 room checks
waste.tool: mcd room --apply or a dry-run of lantern spots on the grid before the first make, so the lamp goes in the first pass.

waste.what: Checked the lane clearance and the first-cell-inside-the-arch rule by reading the floor grid rather than from a rule.
waste.cost: one read of the plan grid and a mental pass over each doorway
waste.tool: mcd plan could mark each doorway's first inside cell as a keep-clear cell, so a furniture layout that blocks it fails before the build.

companions.task: Confirm the stair flight's rail side and whether its tread cells at y5 are open, so the seat and lanterns can be placed against the real stair instead of the plan's guessed footprint.
Review the light map before the first build so the lantern spots under the stair and the hanging lanterns are placed in one pass, not two.
